Correction: '20 mph in a posted school zone during recess and while children are going to or leaving school'.

Card 'Default speed limits' definition: '20 mph school zone during school hours' → same correction ('20 mph in a posted school zone during recess and when children are arriving or leaving'), source ORC 4511.21(B)(1)(a).
